exposure: Normal placentation and no cesarean delivery history
cohort: 443 patients who underwent a second-trimester pregnancy termination between January 2009 and December 2015
finding: Mifepristone combined with ethacridine lactate was found to be safe and effective for second-trimester pregnancy termination in patients with low placentation or/and prior cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Patients with prior cesarean section had higher blood loss than the normal group, as well as patients with both placenta previa and prior cesarean.
